definitions.explanation: In the way of incense ({香道|こうどう}), the act of savoring the fragrance of warmed incense wood. The scent is said to be 'listened to' ({聞|き}く) rather than merely smelled, reflecting the meditative attention it requires.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞香|もんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: There is a proper etiquette for appreciating incense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{香炉|こうろ}→香炉：06296_kouro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}けて→落ち着ける：19903_ochitsukeru⟧{聞香|もんこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took the incense burner in my hands and, calming my mind, appreciated the fragrance.

notes:
A core practice of ⟦{香道|こうどう}→香道：29522_koudou⟧. The word pairs ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ 'to listen' with ⟦{香|こう}→香：17307_kou⟧ 'incense', capturing how the fragrance is received with full, quiet attention. Sometimes also read ぶんこう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聞香|もんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appreciate incense
- ⟦{香|こう}→香：17307_kou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to 'listen' to a fragrance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{香道|こうどう}→香道：29522_koudou⟧: the way of incense — the broader art that includes {聞香|もんこう}
- {組香|くみこう}: an incense-identification game played in ⟦{香道|こうどう}→香道：29522_koudou⟧
